sdk.//: latestFeature, not minor: 'minor' prefers the highest patch of the requested feature band (10.0.2xx) over rolling forward, so on a machine that has 10.0.2xx and 10.0.4xx side by side it picks the 2xx - whose Roslyn is 5.3, while CodeGenerators is built against 5.6 and fails to load with CS9057. latestFeature takes the newest 10.0.x installed instead.
